part.text: I’m creating a throwaway XcodeGen project with a UI test target that will drive the existing Element app by accessibility. After that I’ll run it and adjust the tap targets if needed.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: autoui/project.yml
+name: AutoUI
+options:
+  minimumXcodeGenVersion: 2.43.0
+targets:
+  DummyApp:
+    type: application
+    platform: iOS
+    sources:
+      - path: DummyApp
+    settings:
+      base:
+        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.autoui.dummy
+        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
+        CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
+        CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED: NO
+        SWIFT_VERSION: 5.0
+  AutoUITests:
+    type: bundle.ui-testing
+    platform: iOS
+    sources:
+      - path: AutoUITests
+    dependencies:
+      - target: DummyApp
+    settings:
+      base:
+        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.autoui.tests
+        GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
+        CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
+        CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED: NO
+        SWIFT_VERSION: 5.0
+schemes:
+  AutoUI:
+    build:
+      targets:
+        DummyApp: all
+        AutoUITests: all
+    test:
+      targets:
+        - AutoUITests
*** Add File: autoui/DummyApp/AutoUIApp.swift
+import SwiftUI
+
+@main
+struct AutoUIApp: App {
+    var body: some Scene {
+        WindowGroup {
+            Text("AutoUI")
+        }
+    }
+}
*** Add File: autoui/AutoUITests/ElementUITests.swift
+import XCTest
+
+final class ElementUITests: XCTestCase {
+    func testOpenWeekendPlansAttachmentMenu() {
+        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
+        if app.state != .runningForeground {
+            app.launch()
+        }
+
+        let room = app.staticTexts["Weekend Plans"]
+        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
+        room.tap()
+
+        let composeField = app.textViews.firstMatch
+        XCTAssertTrue(composeField.waitForExistence(timeout: 20))
+
+        let moreButton = app.buttons["Add"]
+        if moreButton.exists {
+            moreButton.tap()
+        } else {
+            app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.08, dy: 0.92)).tap()
+        }
+    }
+}
*** End Patch
